house.description: Cohabitation contract terminology updated to gender-neutral terms.

House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Judiciary Finance and Civil Law

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to contracts; updating terminology to gender-neutral terms; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 513.075.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 513.075, is amended to read:

513.075 COHABITATION; PROPERTY AND FINANCIAL AGREEMENTS.
If sexual relations between the parties are contemplated, a contract between [-a man and a woman-][+ the parties+] who are living together in this state out of wedlock, or who are about to commence living together in this state out of wedlock, is enforceable as to terms concerning the property and financial relations of the parties only if:
(1) the contract is written and signed by the parties; and
(2) enforcement is sought after termination of the relationship.
